basis: FCC 90.219 and delay compliance plate (grade E); the carrier count per band is a job input and not assumed here

erp_per_channel.note: FCC 90.219(d)(3)(i): 5 W ERP per retransmitted channel; the SF ERRCS requirements also cap the peak DL composite at +37 dBm (9.5.4.1) and the UL ERP at the donor at +24 dBm per channel (9.5.3.1)

uplink_noise_erp.note: satisfied by the squelch design in the quiescent state; verify at the no-harm acceptance test (Collier method)

delay.note: NTIA TR-11-480: a 12.5 kHz filter alone is at least 80 us; 25/75/200 kHz bring the floor to 40/13.3/5 us. Collier recommends 25 or 75 kHz.

cross_building_isolation.rule: any ERRCS within 300 ft of another building's ERRCS: at least 100 dB cross isolation; relocate the donor or the antennas or add head-end attenuation (PCTEL OPT014-1 procedure; BDA gain 80 dB with a 20 dB target validates 100 dB)

class_b_registration: Class B boosters must be registered in the FCC signal booster database; record the ID in the equipment list
